نجرمز (form IVq)
# نَجْرَمِزُّ (najramizzu) /nad͡ʒ.ra.miz.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْرَمَزَّ (ijramazza)
# نَجْرَمِزَّ (najramizza) /nad͡ʒ.ra.miz.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْرَمَزَّ (ijramazza)
# نَجْرَمِزِّ (najramizzi) /nad͡ʒ.ra.miz.zi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْرَمَزَّ (ijramazza)
